# Ultimate Engine (FreeXStudio)

> A document, chart and blueprint engine: Markdown and figure specs in; self-contained pages for people and JSON records for software and AI agents out. Runs locally. Free of charge in this version; proprietary license; source not published.

## Pages
- README.md: what it is, install, automatic updates, price and license
- docs/CHARTS.md: every chart and diagram kind, the question each answers, and whether it writes a per-mark record
- docs/HOW_IT_WORKS.md: how one build produces a page and a record
- docs/INSTALL.md: requirements, commands, menu
- docs/VERIFY.md: how to verify a download
- CHANGELOG.md: what changed in each version
- LICENSE.md, PRIVACY.md, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md: terms
- SUPPORT.md, SECURITY.md: help and private security reports

## For an agent using an installed copy
Start at ~/.ultimate-engine/current/skills/choose-a-chart/SKILL.md.
